item.title: HALESTORM Drops New Song 'RAIN YOUR BLOOD ON ME' From Upcoming Album 'EVEREST'
item.description: Halestorm has released a new single titled “Rain Your Blood On Me,” giving fans another preview of the band’s next studio album, Everest, due out August 8 through Atlantic Records (listen below).

item.title: HALESTORM Releases New Music Video for 'DARKNESS ALWAYS WINS': 'Evil Prevails And The Good Depart First'
item.description: Halestorm has unveiled a new official video for “Darkness Always Wins,” the band’s first release of 2025 (watch it below). Directed by DJay Brawner and produced by Dave Cobb, the song builds slowly with a cinematic tone and sits firmly in the band’s hard rock catalog.

item.title: Lzzy Hale Opens Up About New Vocal Mastery After 28 Years Fronting Halestorm
item.description: Long before Lzzy Hale stood under arena lights, she was perched in a dogwood tree somewhere along the Appalachian Trail, testing her voice against the leaves and scaring squirrels.

item.title: Inside Halestorm’s Risky Recording Process for New Album Everest
item.description: Halestorm walked into Everest with a backpack full of unfinished songs. Turns out, producer Dave Cobb didn’t want any of it. “We’re not doing demos. I hate demos,” he told them.

item.title: Is Lzzy Hale the Future Voice of Linkin Park? Fans Think So
item.description: Linkin Park has been pulling some real grade-A stunts lately. Countdowns leading to… more countdowns. Announcements that announce other announcements. It’s like watching a toddler try to explain a magic trick—it’s messy, pointless, and you’re not even mad, just confused.
